description: This file defines the TimerNotificationService, an Android IntentService responsible for managing timer-related notifications such as showing timer completion, deleting timers, and restarting timers within a wearable device application.

classes.name: TimerNotificationService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that manages notifications for the timer, including showing when the timer is done, deleting, and restarting the timer.

methods.name: TimerNotificationService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a specific name/tag.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, called when the service is created.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to show, delete, or restart the timer based on the action specified.

methods.name: restartAlarm
methods.description: Restarts the timer by launching SetTimerActivity.

methods.name: deleteTimer
methods.description: Cancels the countdown notification and cancels the alarm associated with the timer.

methods.name: showTimerDoneNotification
methods.description: Shows a notification indicating the timer has finished, with an action to restart the timer.
